findings.explanation: The description alert condition lists raw scoring thresholds rather than the composite alerting criteria actually enforced in the SPL (significant NPS drops >5 pts, CSAT <80%, incident correlations, or post-launch benchmark drops).
findings.suggested_fix: Update description to summarize the actual composite alert conditions: statistically significant weekly NPS shifts (>5 pts), CSAT falling below 80%, scores correlated to major incidents, or post-launch drops below benchmark.

summary: Detailed implementation and domain-specific interpretation modes are exceptional, but description and control tests contain templated, disjointed threshold conditions that contradict the SPL filtering logic.
